description: Runs Renovate with solrbot, as apache/solr does; see apache/solr's dev-docs/dependency-upgrades.adoc

packageRules.description: CATCH-ALL: bundle all remaining minor/patch bumps into one PR to cut churn. Major bumps are intentionally NOT grouped - they stay as individual PRs. The groups below override this for their packages.

Error Prone, its Gradle plugin and NullAway are grouped on their own because compiler-check upgrades routinely surface new bug patterns that require source fixes, so they need dedicated review separate from the catch-all bump PR.
cyclonedx-core-java (buildSrc) must stay on the version the org.cyclonedx.bom plugin uses, so the SBOM reader and writer share one model. Bump it by hand together with the plugin.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month
